tools.name: view_records
tools.description: The patient's medical records, newest first.
tools.sql: SELECT id, date, type, provider, summary FROM records ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT COALESCE(:limit, 20)

tools.name: get_record
tools.sql: SELECT r.id, r.date, r.type, r.provider, r.summary, p.full_name AS patient, p.mrn FROM records r JOIN patients p ON p.id = r.patient_id WHERE r.id = :record_id

tools.name: list_appointments
tools.sql: SELECT id, datetime, provider, location, reason, status FROM appointments ORDER BY datetime

tools.name: list_prescriptions
tools.description: Current and expired prescriptions with refills remaining.
tools.sql: SELECT id, medication, dosage, prescriber, refills_left, status FROM prescriptions ORDER BY status, medication

resources.name: Patient Records
resources.description: All medical records for the patient

prompts.name: summarize_visit
prompts.description: Summarize one medical record for the patient in plain language.
prompts.template: Call get_record for {{record_id}} and explain what it says in plain, patient-friendly language. Do not show raw field names.
